name: Claims Lodgement Officer redirects non-claims inquiries from greeting

chat_history.message: I want to check the status of my existing claim.

success_condition: The agent must redirect the caller to 1300 943 690 for claim status inquiries, and ask if they also have a new claim to lodge.

success_examples.response: For claim status inquiries, please call our standard support line on 1300 943 690 — they'll be able to help. Is there anything else about lodging a new claim I can assist with?

failure_examples.response: Sure, let me look up your claim status. What's your claim number?
